title: The Perfect School
requirement: Surface with 4 Schooling creatures attached in one expedition.
reward: Unlock Schoolmaster's Charm for purchase: your first Schooling Catch each expedition has −1 weight.

title: The Collector
requirement: Surface with creatures representing at least 5 distinct tags.
reward: Unlock a new special Event card.

title: Risk Taker
requirement: Successfully surface while overloaded in 3 separate expeditions.
reward: Unlock Salvager's Kit for purchase: once per expedition, release one attached creature and draw 1 Technique.
